measures.id: City of New Iberia - Amends Section 3-06
measures.title: City of New Iberia - Amends Section 3-06 - CC
measures.summary: Asks whether to amend Section 3-06 of the New Iberia Home Rule Charter, as set out in Ordinance 2026-08 adopted by the City Council on April 7, 2026, to revise the mayor's compensation. The change would take effect at the start of the mayor's next regular term, scheduled to begin January 1, 2029.
measures.yesMeans: The charter is amended to revise the mayor's pay starting with the term that begins in 2029.
measures.noMeans: The charter section on the mayor's pay stays as it is.
